post.description:
Every written customer review for a Newegg US item, 100 per page: rating, title, text, pros, cons, public display name, ISO submission time, purchased-from-Newegg flag, helpful votes and photo count, plus the item's review total and star distribution. Sort newest, helpful, highest_rating or lowest_rating; page with next_cursor until it is null. For incremental sync use sort newest and stop at the first known review_id, or pass since.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

cursor.description: Opaque `next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page and keep `sort` unchanged while paging.

item_number.description: Newegg item number as used by product: N82E16819113793, 19-113-793 or marketplace 9SIC3DRM4F6818. Marketplace listings return the review pool shared by their product group. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]{3,23})[A-Za-z0-9]$.

since.description: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). With sort newest, returns only reviews submitted on or after it and stops paging at the first older review. Reviews carry a stable review_id for de-duplicating the overlap. Pattern: ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$.

sort.description:
Review order. Use newest for incremental sync: submitted_at is non-increasing across pages.

Provider reference: allowed values ["newest", "helpful", "highest_rating", "lowest_rating"]; default "newest".

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints
